title: Lake Louise Moraine Lake Emerald Lake and Johnston Canyon Tour
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover the stunning beauty of Banff National Park on this comprehensive day tour from Calgary. Explore iconic sites such as Lake Louise and Moraine Lake, soaking in breathtaking views and vibrant landscapes. With an expert local guide, navigate through this natural wonderland and enjoy engaging stories and insider knowledge. The tour includes convenient pick-up from Calgary, ensuring a seamless experience. Enjoy ample time for lunch in Banff town, plus coffee and cookies provided during the journey. This tour is perfect for families, couples, and solo travelers alike, with a maximum group size of 24 for a more personalized experience.

- Full-day tour (8 to 10 hours) covering Lake Louise, Moraine Lake, Emerald Lake, Johnstone Canyon and Banff Town
- Convenient pick-up and drop-off service from Calgary, Canmore, or Banff
- Expert local guides sharing engaging stories and insights
- Small group size guarantee for a more intimate experience
